known.title: The repaired close test uses a close by a second pull request, but plan.mjs refuses that close with another message before the settle-wait check
known.locator: Research, Decisions 3 (line 27); Steps, row 3 settle_refusal_tests, Done when (line 47); Do not touch (line 65)
known.summary: Decision 3 (line 27) says that a later close by a second merged pull request reaches the settle-wait refusal without a change to plan.mjs. At repo_ref, the settle-wait check first calls closedByPullRequest (plan.mjs lines 1230-1231). That function fails with "plan #<n> was closed by <closer> after pull request #<pr> merged" when the closer is not the merged pull request (plan.mjs lines 1135-1149); the test at scripts/tests/plan-cli/reopen.test.mjs line 117 shows this path. So the test gets that refusal, not "changed during the settle wait", and step 3 cannot pass without a change to plan.mjs, which Do not touch forbids. Only a later close by the same pull request reaches the settle-wait refusal.
